title: Microglial SIRPα loss promotes and accelerates aging-associated glial activation in white matter
title_zh: 微胶质细胞SIRPα缺失促进并加速白质中与衰老相关的胶质细胞激活
abstract: Abstract In the aging brain, white matter is a major site of glial activation; however, the molecular mechanisms and key signaling molecules that govern this process remain poorly understood. Signal regulatory protein α (SIRPα) is a phagocytic checkpoint receptor expressed in microglia and macrophages. Microglia-specific deletion of SIRPα in mice (cKO mice) leads to the selective emergence of CD11c-positive microglia in white matter regions; notably, these mice exhibit attenuated demyelination in a cuprizone model, suggesting that SIRPα-deficient microglia may exert protective effects in white matter. Here, we show that CD11c-positive microglia were preferentially observed in the fimbria and periventricular region, white matter areas where a small number of CD11c-positive microglia are also detected in wild-type mice. Bulk RNA sequencing of the fimbria and optic nerve revealed that adult cKO mice already exhibited an aging-associated transcriptional profile, with upregulation of genes associated with white matter-associated microglia and astrocyte activation, along with modest induction of disease-associated oligodendrocyte genes. Immunohistochemical analysis confirmed a significant increase in glial fibrillary acidic protein-positive astrocytes specifically in white matter regions where CD11c-positive microglia were observed. Confocal imaging further demonstrated that activated microglia and reactive astrocytes were frequently found in close apposition. In contrast, oligodendrocyte lineage cells showed no overt histological changes. Canonical senescence effectors were not coherently induced, and the activated microglia retained Lamin B1 without accumulation of 53BP1 foci, indicating aging-associated activation rather than cellular senescence. Genotype-dependent glial activation remained evident in aged cKO mice, in which CD11c-positive microglia also accumulated lipofuscin-like granules, a histological feature of aged microglia. Despite exhibiting more pronounced aging-associated glial activation than aged control mice, aged cKO mice showed no overt MBP-defined myelin loss, and their motor performance in the rotarod test was significantly better preserved than that of aged control mice. These findings suggest that microglial SIRPα acts as a checkpoint molecule that restrains aging-associated glial activation in white matter, and that the resulting activation of microglia and astrocytes is not accompanied by overt MBP-defined myelin loss or accelerated motor decline. Whether this state reflects an adaptive response or an early, still-compensated stage of chronic activation remains to be determined.
abstract_zh: 摘要：在衰老大脑中，白质是胶质细胞激活的主要部位；然而，调控这一过程的分子机制和关键信号分子尚不清楚。信号调节蛋白α（SIRPα）是一种在微胶质细胞和巨噬细胞中表达的吞噬检查点受体。小鼠中微胶质细胞特异性敲除SIRPα（cKO小鼠）导致白质区域出现CD11c阳性微胶质细胞的选择性出现；值得注意的是，这些小鼠在铜锈模型中表现出减弱的脱髓鞘，提示SIRPα缺失的微胶质细胞可能在白质中发挥保护作用。我们发现CD11c阳性微胶质细胞主要出现在弓状核和脑室周围区域，这些区域在野生型小鼠中也检测到少量CD11c阳性微胶质细胞。对弓状核和视神经进行全转录组测序显示，成年cKO小鼠已表现出与衰老相关的转录特征，白质相关微胶质细胞和星形胶质细胞激活相关基因上调，并伴有疾病相关少突胶质细胞基因的轻度诱导。免疫组化分析证实，在观察到CD11c阳性微胶质细胞的白质区域，胶质纤维酸性蛋白（GFAP）阳性星形胶质细胞显著增加。共聚焦成像进一步显示，激活的微胶质细胞和反应性星形胶质细胞经常紧密接触。相反，少突胶质细胞系细胞未出现明显的组织学改变。经典衰老效应器未同步诱导，激活的微胶质细胞保留Lamin B1且未积累53BP1斑点，表明为衰老相关激活而非细胞衰老。基因型相关的胶质细胞激活在老化cKO小鼠中仍然明显，其中CD11c阳性微胶质细胞也积累了类似脂褐素的颗粒，这是老化微胶质细胞的组织学特征。尽管老化cKO小鼠表现出比老化对照小鼠更明显的衰老相关胶质细胞激活，但未出现明显的MBP定义的髓鞘丢失，其在转子实验中的运动表现也显著优于老化对照小鼠。这些发现表明，微胶质细胞SIRPα充当检查点分子，抑制白质中与衰老相关的胶质细胞激活，且由此产生的微胶质细胞和星形胶质细胞激活并未伴随明显的MBP定义髓鞘丢失或加速的运动衰退。是否这一状态反映了适应性反应或慢性激活的早期、仍被补偿的阶段仍需进一步确定。
